[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Safford Raen''' was a [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] who discovered the [[raen sovra]]. Dr. Raen had initially travelled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tenek (planet)|Tenek]] to study the [[vinna tree]].<ref name="COG" />
